The homotopy class $[g] \in \pi_7(SO(9)) \cong \mathbb{Z}$ is exactly the classifying integer $k$.

$$\partial([\mathrm{id}_{S^8}]) = [g] = k \in \pi_7(SO(9)) \cong \mathbb{Z}.$$

**Conclusion.** The boundary homomorphism $\partial: \pi_8(S^8) \xrightarrow{\cdot\, n} \pi_7(SO(9))$ is multiplication by the classifying integer of the bundle. $$\boxed{n = k}$$
